name: SOC-003: Windows Persistence Mechanism Detected
description: Detects Windows persistence mechanisms including Scheduled Task creation (schtasks), Windows Service installation (sc create), and Registry Run key modifications.
aql_expression: SELECT QIDNAME(qid) as EventName, sourceIP, destinationIP, username, LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) as LogSource, payload, starttime FROM events WHERE LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) ILIKE '%Windows%' AND (payload ILIKE '%schtasks%/create%' OR payload ILIKE '%Register-ScheduledTask%' OR payload ILIKE '%sc%create%' OR payload ILIKE '%New-Service%' OR payload ILIKE '%CurrentVersion\Run%') ORDER BY starttime DESC LAST 300 SECONDS
